about: Granules India Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical formulation intermediates (PFIs), finished dosages (FDs), and peptides CDMO in India and internationally. It offers paracetamol, metformin, guaifenesin, ibuprofen, and methocarbamol, as well as prescription and over-the-counter products.
